# AV-A5-redis

The independent auditor's verdict on the path map of the redis copy (W2-88b smoke run, DEC-1176 (3) (a)), given
before any move. It judges the path map only, never memory: no index, embedding, store or retrieval question is
judged here. The auditor session ran no stage of this adoption (the stages ran in session
lead-ac1f3754-57cb-46aa-99c0-37884f8ab5a1).

## What was checked, and how

All records were read as committed at HEAD 4583708a93bcf9f33bcb2e1ddd359d604bc7ddf5 (`git show HEAD:<path>`); each
working-tree copy equals its committed bytes. The checks were made against the gate's code
(`src/gov/adopt/stages.py` A3 207-398, A4 401-425, A5/guard 432-478, A6 572-600; `src/gov/adopt/project.py`
chain, classify, unknown; `src/gov/adopt/legacy.py` retire).

1. Chain. A0 to A4 each record their own stage and `stands_on` the sha256 of the record before them (A0 null): sound.
2. Inventory (A1). 1963 artefacts, unique, sorted; equal path for path and blob to the tree of A1's `commit`
   (5c3783904bdc) less `governance/adoption/**`; equal also to the tree at HEAD less `governance/adoption/**`
   (0 added, 0 removed, 0 changed since A1). The tree at HEAD holds 1968 entries: 1908 mode 100644, 60 mode 100755,
   no symlink and no submodule; the other 5 are the stage records under `governance/adoption/`.
3. Unknown artefacts (CAP-06.c). `governance/project/path-map.yaml` key `namespaces.all.paths` is `['**']`; A2's
   `artefacts` name 1963 paths, the same as A1 in the same order, each in namespace `all`; A2 `unknown: []`,
   `packages: []`. Nothing blocks A6 or A8 on this ground. A file added later anywhere in the tree (this verdict
   included, under `governance/reviews/`) is held by `**`, so the guard's unknown check stays empty.
4. Embedding policy (stages.py 326-345). The one namespace, `all`, states `embedding_policy: embedded`, written
   exactly so; at least one namespace says `embedded`: sound. `capabilities.code_intelligence.enabled: true`, which
   A3 records as `code_intelligence: true`.
5. Target path map (A3). `artefacts` are A1's 1963 paths in A1's order, each with keys `path` and `action` only and
   action `KEEP`; none under `governance/adoption/`. The proposal at `redis-out/proposal.yaml` hashes to A3's
   `proposal_sha256` (f3bae0bb...) and is `artefacts: []`, so every KEEP is the default the code gives, none an action
   the proposal did not give. No artefact moves, so no move into or out of a native package layout needs grounds
   (CAP-44.j); the tree holds none of the manifests the code knows (pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg,
   package.json, Cargo.toml, pom.xml, build.gradle) in any case. No target, no batch, no kind, no RETIRE.
6. Batched plan (A4). `path_map_hash` and `stands_on` equal the A3 record's sha256 (6f9a287a...); `batches: []`,
   `dependents: []`, `retirements: []`. Recomputed from A3 as `_plan` does it: 0 executed artefacts, 0 dependents,
   0 retirements; A4 is exactly the plan A3 yields, so the guard's PLAN_NOT_THE_PATH_MAPS check holds.
7. A6 and A8 as this map leaves them. A6 has no batch to run: nothing is moved or deleted from the active tree.
   A8 retires only what A3 marks RETIRE: nothing. No legacy rule file stands in the tree (no CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md,
   .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, nothing under .claude/, .cursor/ or .rulesync/), so nothing is imported or left
   loaded unretired. Nothing in the map moves, retires or deletes what it should not.

## Findings

None that blocks. Observations, recorded and not blocking:

- O1 (path-map.yaml `namespaces.all`): one namespace `**` holds the whole repository. It is correct and safe for A6
  and A8 (nothing is unknown, nothing moves); whether it is a good taxonomy is not judged (the brief's minimal
  smoke-run input). Ordinary work: yes, because it is the adopter's input as given. Consequence: other.
  Reversed by: a tracked path that `**` does not match under the doctor's matcher.
- O2 (A4 `batches: []`, A3 all KEEP): A6 and A8 will run as no-ops beyond their records and the index refresh; the
  smoke run exercises their gates, not a move or a retirement. Ordinary work: yes. Consequence: other.
  Reversed by: a proposal that names an action.

## Verdict: pass

The path map holds every tracked artefact (0 unknown), states a valid embedding policy with one namespace embedded,
records A1's inventory exactly with KEEP throughout as the empty proposal gives, and A4 is exactly its plan. A6 and
A8 can go ahead on it safely and as the gate's rules say: nothing will be moved, retired or deleted.
